image_description: A black and white photograph of a narrow, dimly lit staircase viewed from the bottom looking up. The stairs are flanked by brick walls on both sides. A handrail runs along both walls, supported by brackets attached to the brickwork. At the top of the stairs, there is a landing with a horizontal railing section visible against a bright light source (likely a window or skylight).
